en.name: ApexMarketWatch
en.subtitle: Quotes, charts and 13F filings
en.short_description: Live quotes and charts, plus what the big funds filed with the SEC.
en.description:
ApexMarketWatch is a market watchlist that shows you its sources.

WATCHLIST
Add the tickers you care about and see the last price, the day's high and low, and the 52-week range. Tap through for a price chart and a sparkline over the range you pick.

13F WHALES
Institutional holdings read straight from SEC EDGAR — gross buying, gross selling, and what changed. The SEC's public filing data, not a newsletter's summary of it.

CRASH INDEX
A drawdown-based read on how far a name has fallen from its own high, so a headline number has context.

HONEST PROVENANCE
Every screen labels where its numbers came from. Quotes come from Yahoo Finance's public chart endpoint by default; a build can supply a Finnhub key instead. When a source is unavailable the app says so rather than quietly showing you something stale.

NOT ADVICE
ApexMarketWatch reports public market data. It does not recommend trades, hold your money, or connect to a broker.
